rootFurther.intro:
Facing the whirlwind of change in the AI era and ever-rising expectations from customers, Sun* has chosen a strategy of diversifying capabilities — not only striving to be the elite in its own field, but aiming for a higher goal, where every Sunner is a “problem-solver”, an expert at resolving every issue and finding answers to every challenge of projects, customers and society.
Inspired by diversity of capability, the ability to grow flexibly, and the spirit of digging deep to break through in the AI era, “Root Further” was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025.
Beyond its surface meaning, “Root Further” is the journey in which we keep reaching farther, rooting deeper, touching the hidden “geological” layers so we can survive, rise, and nurture the ever-burning passion for creating value that defines Sun* people.
rootFurther.quote:
“A tree with deep roots fears no storm”
(An English proverb)
rootFurther.closing: Before the storm, only trees with strong enough roots can stand firm. An organization of individuals confident in their diverse capabilities — ready to create, embrace challenges, and master change — is one that not only stands steady amid upheaval but also harnesses every advantage and conquers the challenges of the times. More than the name of a new chapter in the organization's journey, “Root Further” is an encouragement, urging each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dare to dig deep, unlock every potential, break past limits, and become the most versatile, excellent version of ourselves.

kudos.label: Recognition movement
kudos.title: Sun* Kudos
kudos.body: A movement to recognize and thank colleagues — held for the first time for all Sunners. Launching in November 2025, it encourages Sun* people to share words of recognition and gratitude to colleagues on the system announced by the organizing committee. It will serve as reference material for the Heads Council when selecting award recipients.
